cues: Merozoites burst out and invade red blood cells.

text: Merozoites burst out and invade red blood cells. Inside each cell the parasite grows, divides, and every forty eight hours the red cells burst together, releasing new merozoites and toxins. That synchronised bursting is the fever: a cold stage with shivering, a hot stage, then sweating. Every third day: tertian malaria.
